For Q3/2024 and Q3/2025 sales revenue was 243.04 MB and 
208.69 MB respectively, decreased by 34.35 MB or (14.13%), due 
to a decrease in overall customer demand and a reduction in 
selling prices in line with the trend of global chemical raw 
material prices. 
Medical grade plastic compound decrease (8.68%), attributed 
to price competition of end product in the market.Revenue
For 9M/2025, the Company's gross profit margin increased due 
to effective production cost management and reduced selling 
and administrative expenses. This resulted in a total gross 
profit 85.77 MB or 13.60%, increased from 39.70 MB or +5.84% in 
9M/2024.For 9M/2025, ADB Plastic Compound business and 
Subsidiary (ADB Bio) net profit was 6.62 million baht. 
We received profit from investment in associate company, 
ADBS , for 17.13 million baht. 
Consequently, the Company's total net profit amounted 
to 23.60 million baht . (+24.97 million baht compared 
9M/2024)Net Profit
Our profit margin was rebound from last year due to 
the stability trend of major material costs of 
production including PVC Resin and Plasticizers.
